reports.summary: 本轮增量检索收录 2 项 2026-08-19 首次公开且高度相关的新工作：`ADEPT` 聚焦用大规模强化学习把预训练和后训练结合起来，推动多自由度灵巧手在视触觉输入下完成长时序任务；`LabDex` 则提出面向化学实验室的层级式灵巧操作基准与数据集，强调真实实验室交互、长时程流程和跨平台评测。两者都把灵巧手或灵巧操作放在主线位置，因此纳入本次更新。
reports.summary_en: This incremental pass adds 2 newly public and highly relevant items first released on 2026-08-19. `ADEPT` proposes a large-scale RL framework that combines pre-training and post-training to advance high-DoF dexterous manipulation from raw visuo-tactile input, while `LabDex` introduces a hierarchical benchmark and dataset for dexterous manipulation in chemistry laboratories with real-world lab interaction and long-horizon evaluation. Both place dexterous hands or dexterous manipulation at the center, so they are included in this update.

reports.summary: 本轮增量检索仅发现 1 项真正新增且高相关的工作：`Physics-Informed Sliding-Window Particle Filtering for Tactile-Only In-Hand 6-DoF Object Pose Refinement`。它于 2026-08-18 首次公开，聚焦仅依赖触觉的手内物体位姿精修，是典型的灵巧手与在手操作问题，因此纳入本次更新。
reports.summary_en: This incremental pass found only 1 truly new and highly relevant item: `Physics-Informed Sliding-Window Particle Filtering for Tactile-Only In-Hand 6-DoF Object Pose Refinement`. First public on 2026-08-18, it focuses on tactile-only in-hand object pose refinement, which is a classic dexterous-hand and in-hand manipulation problem, so it is included in this update.

reports.summary: 本轮增量检索发现 2 项新近公开且相关性较高的工作，均在 2026-08-17 首次公开。ViHaTeleop 聚焦低成本视触觉遥操作，用于采集灵巧操作示教并验证触觉反馈对接触关键任务的帮助；H-PAC Hand 聚焦欠驱动灵巧手的控制建模与腱弹性补偿，直接改善手部姿态可重复性。两者都把灵巧手或灵巧操作作为核心贡献，纳入本次更新。
reports.summary_en: This incremental pass found 2 newly public, highly relevant items, both first released on 2026-08-17. ViHaTeleop focuses on low-cost visual-haptic teleoperation for collecting dexterous manipulation demonstrations and shows that tactile feedback helps contact-critical tasks; H-PAC Hand focuses on control modeling and tendon-elasticity compensation for an underactuated dexterous hand, directly improving hand pose reproducibility. Both place dexterous hands or dexterous manipulation at the center, so they are included in this update.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到 1 项新的高相关工作：`NestDex`。它把灵巧操作拆成可复用的内层手技能与由视觉语言模块驱动的外层技能选择，核心仍然是多指灵巧手的真实遥操作与任务执行，因此纳入本次更新。
reports.summary_en: This run found 1 newly public, highly relevant work: `NestDex`. It decomposes dexterous manipulation into reusable inner hand skills plus a vision-language-driven outer skill selector, and the core contribution remains real teleoperated dexterous hand execution, so it is included in this update.

reports.summary: 本轮检索到两项与灵巧机器人手直接相关的新公开工作：其一是面向人手到多种机器人灵巧手/手臂形态编辑的 HandEdit 基准，其二是关于类人双臂灵巧操作中初始姿态依赖与手选择偏差的诊断研究。两者都在 2026-08-12 首次公开，且都把“手”作为核心变量，因此纳入本次更新。
reports.summary_en: This run found two newly public works directly related to dexterous robot hands: HandEdit, a benchmark for editing egocentric human-hand imagery into multiple robotic hand and hand-arm embodiments, and a study diagnosing initial-pose-dependent hand-selection bias in humanoid dual-arm dexterous manipulation. Both were first public on 2026-08-12 and both place the hand as a central variable, so they are included in this update.
